title: Common sheafified pure tensor section at independent universe sizes
statement: For an essentially small site C with a sheaf R of commutative rings in an independent coefficient universe, and sheaves of R-modules M,N, the pure section of M tensor N is the image of the sectionwise pure tensor under the module-sheafification unit followed by the inverse tensor/sheafification comparison. This construction uses the actual sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and asserts no existence choice.
